headlines.title_en: Preview: State Council Information Office holds regular policy briefing of the State Council to introduce work on strengthening governance of the difficulty SMEs face in getting paid
headlines.summary_en: The State Council Information Office will hold a regular State Council policy briefing at 3:00 p.m. on Monday, September 14, 2026, and has invited Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology Ke Jixin and responsible officials from the People's Bank of China, the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council, the State Administration for Market Regulation, and the China Securities Regulatory Commission to introduce work related to strengthening the governance of the difficulty small and medium-sized enterprises face in collecting payments, and to answer questions from journalists.

headlines.title: 法国央行就债务问题发表声明，驳斥“虚假信息”
headlines.summary: 法国央行发表声明，否认其在市场上出售了债务持仓，此前该央行遭到让-吕克·梅朗雄及其极左翼政党的批评。 该声明是对埃里克·科克雷尔言论的回应，后者称法国央行持有的证券投资组合出现了“令人担忧”的缩减。 法国央行表示，“自收购以来，这些证券均未在市场上出售”，并愿意向国民议会财政委员会解释其货币政策操作。

headlines.title_en: France's central bank issues a statement on debt issues, refuting 'false information'
headlines.summary_en: The Bank of France issued a statement denying that it had sold debt holdings in the market, after the central bank came under criticism from Jean-Luc Mélenchon and his far-left party. The statement was a response to remarks by Eric Coquerel, who said the securities portfolio held by the Bank of France had shrunk in a "worrying" way. The Bank of France said that "since acquisition, none of these securities have been sold on the market," and that it was willing to explain its monetary policy operations to the National Assembly's finance committee.

headlines.summary_zh: 中国8月份工厂出厂价格增速加快，而消费者通胀再次抬头，原因在于与美以对伊朗战争相关的能源和大宗商品成本波动。国家统计局周三发布的数据显示，上月生产者价格指数同比上涨3.8%，高于7月份的3.5%。

headlines.title: 廖岷出席中国-世界银行集团全球生态系统与转型中心“两山”理念高级别研讨会
headlines.summary: 2026年9月7日，中国-世界银行集团全球生态系统与转型中心以“从愿景到行动：修复自然生态 促进繁荣发展”为主题，在北京举办“两山”理念高级别研讨会。财政部副部长廖岷出席会议开幕式并致辞。廖岷表示，中方呼吁世界银行等多边开发银行为发展中国家加强生态保护提供更多资金、技术和知识，并期待全球中心发挥好知识分享平台作用，提供更多全球公共产品。（财政部）

headlines.title_en: Liao Min attends the China-World Bank Group Global Ecosystem and Transformation Center high-level seminar on the 'Two Mountains' concept
headlines.summary_en: On September 7, 2026, the China-World Bank Group Global Ecosystem and Transformation Center held in Beijing a high-level seminar on the "Two Mountains" concept under the theme "From Vision to Action: Restoring Natural Ecosystems to Promote Prosperity and Development." Vice Minister of Finance Liao Min attended the opening ceremony and delivered remarks. Liao Min said that China calls on multilateral development banks such as the World Bank to provide more funding, technology, and knowledge to developing countries to strengthen ecological protection, and looks forward to the global center playing a good role as a knowledge-sharing platform and providing more global public goods. (Ministry of Finance)

headlines.title: 报告：长三角已成为我国最具活力的区域创新高地之一
headlines.summary: 9月11日至14日，2026浦江创新论坛（第十九届）在上海举办。中国科学技术发展战略研究院党委书记刘冬梅在论坛期间发布《中国区域科技创新评价报告2026》。报告显示，我国区域科技创新水平持续提升，上海综合科技创新水平保持全国第一，江苏、浙江、安徽均进入全国前十。长三角在研发资源、财政科技投入、创新产出等方面，主要指标值占全国比重均超过30%，已成为我国最具活力的区域创新高地之一。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: Report: The Yangtze River Delta has become one of China's most dynamic regional innovation highlands
headlines.summary_en: From September 11 to 14, the 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum (19th session) was held in Shanghai. Liu Dongmei, Party Secretary of the Chinese Academy of Science and Technology for Development, released the "China Regional Science and Technology Innovation Evaluation Report 2026" during the forum. The report shows that China's regional science and technology innovation level continued to improve, Shanghai maintained the top national ranking in comprehensive science and technology innovation level, and Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Anhui all entered the national top ten. In the Yangtze River Delta, the share of major indicators in research and development resources, fiscal science and technology investment, and innovation output all exceeded 30% of the national total, making it one of China's most dynamic regional innovation highlands. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 中国银行启动“一网三融”算力金融生态共建行动 为算力产业链提供不少于3000亿元综合金融支持
headlines.summary: 【中国银行启动“一网三融”算力金融生态共建行动 为算力产业链提供不少于3000亿元综合金融支持】2026中国算力大会期间，中国银行在工业和信息化部、中国人民银行指导支持下，会同中国电信、中国移动、中国联通、中国人民保险、中国东方资产、国银金融租赁等生态伙伴，共同启动“一网三融”算力金融生态共建行动。“十五五”期间，中国银行将携手保险、产业投资、资产管理和金融租赁等算力生态伙伴，共建“算力+”产业金融生态，为算力产业链上下游企业提供不少于3000亿元综合金融支持，支持不少于100个重点智算中心项目，为国家算力互联互通区域节点提供跨区域、一体化协同金融服务，赋能3000家以上用算企业。

headlines.title_en: Bank of China launches 'One Network, Three Integrations' computing power financial ecosystem co-building initiative, to provide no less than RMB 300 billion in comprehensive financial support for the computing power industry chain
headlines.summary_en: [Bank of China launches the "One Network, Three Integrations" computing power financial ecosystem co-building initiative, providing no less than RMB 300 billion in comprehensive financial support for the computing power industry chain] During the 2026 China Computing Power Conference, Bank of China, under the guidance and support of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the People's Bank of China, together with ecosystem partners including China Telecom, China Mobile, China Unicom, PICC, China Orient Asset Management, and CDB Financial Leasing, jointly launched the "One Network, Three Integrations" computing power financial ecosystem co-building initiative. During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, Bank of China will work with computing power ecosystem partners in insurance, industrial investment, asset management, and financial leasing to jointly build a "computing power+" industrial finance ecosystem, provide no less than RMB 300 billion in comprehensive financial support to upstream and downstream enterprises in the computing power industry chain, support no fewer than 100 key intelligent computing center projects, provide cross-regional, integrated coordinated financial services for national computing power interconnection regional nodes, and empower more than 3,000 computing-using enterprises.

headlines.title_en: New Delhi Declaration of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit (summary): affirms the work of the 7 special working groups under the BRICS industrial channel, and affirms the efforts of the smart manufacturing and robotics working group in smart factory development, solution sharing, standards cooperation and talent training
headlines.summary_en: New Delhi Declaration of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting (Summary): Affirmed the work of the seven special working groups under the BRICS industrial channel, and affirmed the efforts of the smart manufacturing and robotics working group in areas such as smart factory development, solution sharing, standards cooperation, and talent training. Recognized that artificial intelligence provides enormous opportunities for promoting economic growth and achieving sustainable development. Pointed out that using artificial intelligence to promote economic growth and social well-being is crucial for advancing countries, especially Global South countries, toward a just, fair, equal, and prosperous future. Affirmed the Shanghai World AI Conference and the High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance, and recognized their contributions to strengthening international AI cooperation and AI for good. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 习近平会见印度总理莫迪
headlines.summary: 据新华社报道，当地时间9月12日下午，国家主席习近平在印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤期间会见印度总理莫迪。两国领导人坦诚深入交换意见，就中印要做伙伴达成重要共识。 习近平指出，中方始终从战略高度和长远角度看待和发展中印关系。近两年，我同莫迪总理两次会晤，引领中印关系从“再出发”实现“再提升”。两国机制性交往逐步恢复，合作清单不断拉长，双边贸易额再创新高。这一局面来之不易，值得珍惜。中印两国国情不同，完全可以取长补短、相互支持、彼此成就、共同发展。面对变乱交织的国际形势，中国和印度作为世界上人口最多的两个国家和全球南方重要成员，肩负重要责任。双方

headlines.title_en: Xi Jinping meets with Indian Prime Minister Modi
headlines.summary_en: According to Xinhua News Agency, on the afternoon of September 12 local time, President Xi Jinping met with Indian Prime Minister Modi during the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting in New Delhi, India. The leaders of the two countries had a candid and in-depth exchange of views and reached an important consensus that China and India should be partners. Xi Jinping pointed out that China has always viewed and developed China-India relations from a strategic height and long-term perspective. Over the past two years, I have met with Prime Minister Modi twice, guiding China-India relations from "starting anew" to achieving "further elevation." Institutional exchanges between the two countries have gradually resumed, the cooperation list has continued to lengthen, and bilateral trade volume has hit a new high. This situation has not come easily and is worth cherishing. China and India have different national conditions, and can fully draw on each other's strengths, support each other, enable each other's success, and develop together. In the face of a turbulent and intertwined international situation, China and India, as the world's two most populous countries and important members of the Global South, shoulder important responsibilities. headlines.title: 中国算力大会“年度重大突破成果”揭晓
headlines.summary: 2026中国算力大会上，中国算力大会“年度重大突破成果”正式揭晓，15项具有示范性意义的技术成果集中亮相。据了解，2026“算力中国·年度重大突破成果”具有四大特点：一是成果整体技术指标先进，在算力及相关产业领域具备国际先进、国内领先水准，具备行业标杆价值；二是核心技术创新性突出，成果转化落地成效显著，具备较强的行业示范、引领带动与辐射推广作用；三是有效提升行业整体技术能级，赋能产业创新，培育新兴业态，催生新经济增长点；四是注重技术创新的社会效益、经济效益和环境效益，对科技发展具有较大推动作用。

headlines.title_en: China Computing Power Conference announces "Annual Major Breakthrough Achievements"
headlines.summary_en: At the 2026 China Computing Conference, the China Computing Conference "Annual Major Breakthrough Achievements" were officially announced, with 15 demonstrative technological achievements unveiled together. It is understood that the 2026 "Computing China · Annual Major Breakthrough Achievements" have four major characteristics: first, the overall technical indicators of the achievements are advanced, reaching internationally advanced and domestically leading levels in computing power and related industries, and possessing industry benchmark value; second, the core technologies are highly innovative, the results of commercialization and implementation are remarkable, and they have strong industry demonstration, guiding, driving, and diffusion effects; third, they effectively raise the overall technological level of the industry, empower industrial innovation, cultivate emerging business forms, and create new economic growth points; fourth, they emphasize the social, economic, and environmental benefits of technological innovation, and have a significant role in promoting scientific and technological development.

headlines.title: 习近平：中方愿同金砖成员一道，为实现中东海湾地区和平安宁发挥应有作用
headlines.summary: 当地时间9月12日下午，国家主席习近平在新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤第一阶段会议并发表重要讲话。 习近平指出，中东海湾局势仍在复杂演变。这场战事给地区各国人民造成严重损失，也不符合国际社会共同利益。我提出维护和促进中东和平稳定的4点主张，旨在呼吁缓局降温、止战促和。有关各方要坚持政治解决方向，推动实现永久全面停火。中方愿同金砖成员一道，为实现中东海湾地区和平安宁发挥应有作用。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Xi Jinping: China is willing to work with BRICS members to play a due role in achieving peace and tranquility in the Middle East and Gulf region
headlines.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 12 local time, President Xi Jinping attended the first phase of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting in New Delhi and delivered an important speech. Xi Jinping pointed out that the situation in the Middle East and the Gulf is still evolving in a complex manner. This war has caused serious losses to the people of the countries in the region and does not conform to the common interests of the international community. I put forward four propositions for safeguarding and promoting peace and stability in the Middle East, aimed at calling for de-escalation and cooling down, ending the war, and promoting peace. Relevant parties should adhere to the direction of political settlement and push for the realization of a permanent and comprehensive ceasefire. China is willing to work with BRICS members to play its due role in realizing peace and tranquility in the Middle East and Gulf region. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 伊朗立法推动AI发展，拟成立国家人工智能组织
headlines.summary: 据伊朗迈赫尔通讯社报道，伊朗议会议长卡利巴夫已将《国家人工智能发展法》提交总统执行。该法包含12条和8项附注，其报告由工业与矿业委员会提交议会全体会议，经公开会议通过后获宪法监护委员会批准。根据该法案第2条，为组织和发展人工智能生态系统，将成立国家人工智能组织，作为独立机构和全国指导委员会秘书处，仅使用现有设施、预算和人力，并遵守相关法律法规，在总统领导下运作。

headlines.title_en: Iran legislates to promote AI development, plans to establish a national artificial intelligence organization
headlines.summary_en: According to Iran's Mehr News Agency, Iranian Parliament Speaker Qalibaf has submitted the "National Artificial Intelligence Development Law" to the president for implementation. The law contains 12 articles and 8 notes, and its report was submitted by the Industry and Mines Committee to the parliament's plenary session, passed in a public session, and then approved by the Guardian Council. According to Article 2 of the bill, in order to organize and develop the artificial intelligence ecosystem, a National Artificial Intelligence Organization will be established as an independent body and the secretariat of the national steering committee, using only existing facilities, budgets, and personnel, and complying with relevant laws and regulations, operating under the leadership of the president.

headlines.title: 我国实现一体化算力统筹监测
headlines.summary: 从工业和信息化部了解到，中国算力平台已实现全国一体化算力统筹监测，我国算力“一张网、一盘棋、一体化”发展格局基本形成。中国算力平台是国家级综合性算力服务平台，目前已经汇聚了超万家注册企业用户，上架2000多项优质算力产品，接入各类大模型超300个，为广大开发者提供算力调用服务，累计沉淀数十亿条算力监测大数据。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: China achieves integrated coordinated monitoring of computing power
headlines.summary_en: Learned from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology that China's computing power platform has achieved nationwide integrated computing power coordinated monitoring, and the development pattern of "one network, one chessboard, integration" for China's computing power has basically taken shape. China's computing power platform is a national-level comprehensive computing power service platform. It has currently gathered more than 10,000 registered enterprise users, listed more than 2,000 high-quality computing power products, connected more than 300 large models of various types, provided computing power invocation services for developers, and accumulated billions of pieces of computing power monitoring big data. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 中国工程院院士邬贺铨：2030年中国算力有望占到全球30%
headlines.summary: 在9月12日2026中国算力大会主论坛上，中国工程院院士邬贺铨指出，智能体的出现带动了Token的消费。今年3月，Token的消费已经达到日均140万亿。随着技术进步，Token的消耗并不是以多为荣，而是以效率为荣。中国Token的应用成本不断下降，这也促进了Token的利用。Token带动算力，算力和Token之间成正比。目前，中国的算力在全球占21%，美国占46%，按照国家算力网的规划，2030年中国算力有望占到全球30%。

headlines.title_en: Chinese Academy of Engineering academician Wu Hequan: China's computing power is expected to account for 30% of the global total by 2030
headlines.summary_en: At the main forum of the 2026 China Computing Conference on September 12, Chinese Academy of Engineering academician Wu Hequan pointed out that the emergence of intelligent agents has driven Token consumption. In March this year, Token consumption had already reached an average of 140 trillion per day. As technology advances, Token consumption is not about taking pride in using more, but about taking pride in efficiency. The application cost of Tokens in China continues to decline, which has also promoted Token utilization. Tokens drive computing power, and computing power and Tokens are directly proportional. At present, China accounts for 21% of global computing power, while the United States accounts for 46%. According to the national computing power network plan, China's computing power is expected to account for 30% of the global total by 2030.

headlines.title_en: CPCA's Cui Dongshu: This round of downturn in the passenger vehicle market is a phased structural fluctuation
headlines.summary_en: Cui Dongshu, Secretary-General of the China Passenger Car Association, wrote in an article that in August 2026, car market retail rebounded 5.5% month-on-month, the result of a combination of multiple factors including high oil prices weighing on the market, weak macroeconomic sentiment, rising policy expectations, and the boost from the Chengdu auto show. Ongoing geopolitical conflicts continue to trouble navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, pushing international oil prices to remain volatile at high levels. In 2026, domestic gasoline prices have cumulatively risen by more than 1,720 yuan per ton, including an increase of 180 yuan since the end of July, greatly raising the cost of using fuel vehicles, and domestic fuel passenger vehicle consumer demand has continued to shrink sharply. In August, the manufacturing PMI rebounded 0.6 percentage points month-on-month to 49.8%, still below the boom-or-bust line. Although marginal terminal domestic demand warmed somewhat, the momentum was limited.
